# Qwen3 30B-A3B Instruct 2507

Alibaba · released 2025-07 · 30.5B params (3.3B active) · apache-2.0

**score 45.5** ±1.1

#133 of 205 · from 30 benchmark results across 8 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Nebius) · $0.15/M blended · $0.1 in / $0.3 out per 1M tokens · [tokenfactory.nebius.com ↗](https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/models/catalog/text2text/Qwen%2FQwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507)

[price source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · USD per 1M text tokens. Nebius standard synchronous API; model Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Uncached input; output includes generated reasoning where billed. Nebius FP8 serving variant; FI / eu-north1. This serving precision is not a claim about benchmark precision. Batch, cache storage, tools and other modalities excluded.

[context specification source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · Nebius API maximum input tokens from exact catalogue record nebius/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507; not the legacy max\_tokens field.

| local download | size | score | command |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 4-bit q4\_k\_m | ~18.8GB | 45.5 | `ollama run qwen3:30b-instruct` |
| 8-bit q8\_0 | ~37.1GB | 45.5 | `ollama run qwen3:30b-a3b-instruct-2507-q8_0` |

The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.
